verdict: Leads and efficiency both slipped this week; intake pipeline needs attention now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 47 leads at a blended cost of $77.58 per lead, but the most recent 7-day window shows leads down 40% and cost per lead up 42% versus the prior 7 days — efficiency is declining, not a deliberate volume reduction. The data points to an intake issue rather than an ads issue: leads are arriving but no consultations are booking, meaning the problem sits after the click. Google Business Profile actions also dropped sharply over a four-day stretch mid-period, which we are monitoring for a pattern. Conversion tracking on the website is currently being repaired, so the number of tracked site conversions under-reports actual activity. Ad creative and bidding adjustments are in motion this week, and the intake workflow is being reviewed to close the gap between leads received and consultations booked.

average cost per lead this period, up 42% in the most recent week

watch_item.issue: Leads are entering your pipeline but zero consultations are booking — the drop-off is happening at intake, not at the ad.
watch_item.fix: The intake workflow is being audited this week to identify and close where prospective clients are falling off before a consultation is scheduled.
